author: Speedy_Petey
body:
Username:Speedy_Petey
Reason Banned: I was scamming (It was a mistake the second time after i had been warned)
Who Banned You: MOD Excellence
Why I should be unbanned:

I believe that I should be unbanned because when I was playing I told people that if they did /hub that they would be able to access a shop. I did this to get them to leave so I could join. I had no idea it wasnt allowed and I was immediately kicked by Excellence. I then came back and I typed /join and did the "t" then "up" trick to repeat /join a few times. I then accidentally hit "t" then "up" too many times and it showed my original message I had been kicked for. Excellence read my repeat message and he banned me for 4 days. I am truly apologetic and meant no harm. It was a complete accident.

My friend is at my house for the weekend and we wanted to play with me. My friend lives a ways away and visits about once a year. He leaves within the next two days and I would love to be unbanned before he leaves. Thank you for your time, have a great day!
